item.title: Tweetintosh 0.1.1
item.description:
### English
- Updated multi-image support: increased the post photo attachment limit to 20, added an interactive bottom thumbnail scrubber in the image lightbox, and adjusted multi-image stream sizing and spacing to preserve aspect ratios without cropping. - Added post translation support: inline "Translate post" / "Show original" under non-target-language posts, supporting both Apple on-device Translation and custom OpenAI-compatible AI (BYOK) endpoints with model verification and dynamic Flash-tier model recommendations. - Fixed various bugs and improved stability (including restoring click-to-open detail on selectable timeline post text).
### 中文
- 主要更新了对多图的支持：将发帖图片上限提升至 20 张，为图片灯箱新增底部缩略图居中滑动条，并优化了多图横向流的按比例展示与间距。 - 新增推文翻译功能：在非目标语言的帖子正文下方提供「翻译帖子 / 显示原文」切换，支持 Apple 本地离线翻译与自定义 AI（BYOK）接口（支持配置目标语言、验证并拉取模型、自动推荐各家最新 Flash 轻量模型）。 - 修复了一些 bug，提升了整体稳定性（包括修复时间线正文开启划选后点击进入详情页的问题）。
